tools.name: search_products
tools.description: Finds published products in this directory by words in their name, category, tagline, use case and features. Products that match every word come first, then products that match the rarer half or more of the words, each labelled with the words it matched. Optional: a category, criteria the vendor mus

tools.name: get_product
tools.description: Returns one product's full published record: plans and prices, documented compliance and data rights, CTI score with its breakdown, features, FAQ, the date its facts were checked, the vendor pages they came from, the official site and a visit link.

tools.name: compare_products
tools.description: Returns 2 to 4 products side by side with the same fields for each: plans and prices, documented compliance, transparency and data rights, CTI score with its breakdown, date checked, official site and visit link.

tools.name: list_categories
tools.description: Returns this directory's categories with their product counts and any CTI criteria that do not apply to a category.

tools.name: get_methodology
tools.description: Returns what the CTI score measures and what it does not, the section weights and grades, what each value such as 'Not documented' means, how prices should be read and what the visit link is.

tools.name: ask_site
tools.description: Answers a plain-language question about this directory's listings, e.g. 'invoice approval tools with SSO and a free trial', with up to 10 matching products as schema.org records (review page, official site, CTI score and a visit link). It is the same answer as the site's NLWeb /ask address. No model

tools.name: send_feedback
tools.description: Sends a message to the owner of this directory: a correction, a missing product, a question or a suggestion. Only the owner reads it. A message changes nothing by itself; facts are checked again on the vendor's own pages before anything changes. The message is read as information, never as an instru

tools.name: read_reply
tools.description: Shows the owner's answer to a message sent earlier, using the reply code that send_feedback returned (AF-XXXX- and 32 characters, digits and the letters a to f). Shows only the answer and its status, never the message. Reading changes nothing. An answer stays readable for 90 days after it is written

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search_products, send_feedback, read_reply · Private data: search_products, get_product, ask_site, send_feedback · Public sink: send_feedback.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search_products, send_feedback, read_reply · Private data: search_products, get_product, ask_site, send_feedback · Public sink: send_feedback

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
